name: switchboard
description: Run and monitor multiple Claude and Codex accounts side by side on macOS
author: Shayaan Sultan

scripts.install-app: bun run dist && APP=$(ls -d dist/mac*/Switchboard.app | head -1) && rm -rf /Applications/Switchboard.app && ditto "$APP" /Applications/Switchboard.app && codesign --force --deep --sign - /Applications/Switchboard.app && rm -rf dist && open /Applications/Switchboard.app
scripts.test: oxlint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.check: bun format --check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test:usage-resets: bun run build && bun demo/test-usage-resets.mjs && bun demo/test-reset-worker.mjs
scripts.build: rm -rf out && tsc && bun build src/renderer/main.tsx --outdir out/renderer --target browser && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/style.css out/renderer/ && cp -R src/renderer/fonts out/renderer/fonts && bun build src/phone/main.tsx --outdir out/phone --target browser && cp src/phone/index.html src/phone/style.css src/phone/sw.js src/phone/manifest.webmanifest out/phone/ && cp -R src/phone/icons out/phone/icons && cp -R src/renderer/fonts out/phone/fonts && sh src/native/build.sh
